content:
Picture Credit: X

The makers of Akshay Kumar’s upcoming sci-fi survival-action thriller ‘Samuk’ have unveiled its motion poster, giving a look into the film’s dark and mysterious world. The film is set in a misty forest backdrop as the poster shows the actor standing in a rugged cave-like setting, dressed in dark gear.

‘Samuk’ motion poster

The motion poster opens with the tagline, “The mission is Human. The enemy is not.” It then features a large, scaly, clawed appendage hanging menacingly above an eerie woodland, hinting at the threat faced by the characters. The visuals move to a dark, moss-covered cave with water flowing over rocks. Akshay appears as a lone figure at the entrance, silhouetted against a bright light.

‘Samuk’ makers tease another update

Along with the motion poster, the makers hinted at another announcement.

Their social media post read, “#SAMUK unveils at 2:07 P.M.”

Akshay Kumar reunites with Vipul Amrutlal Shah

The film is being developed as a sci-fi survival-action thriller. The film is directed by Kanishk Varma. ‘Samuk’ marks the reunion of Akshay Kumar and producer Vipul Amrutlal Shah after 13 years. Shah is backing the project under his Sunshine Pictures banner, with Aashin A. Shah serving as co-producer.The film has reportedly been in development for more than two years.

According to Variety Indian, the team was shooting in London in September. Actor Viineet Kumar Siingh has also reportedly joined the cast.The makers have scheduled Samuk for a theatrical release on May 28, 2027. Further details about the storyline and the rest of the cast are awaited. Akshay Kumar was last seen in the large cast comedy drama, ‘Welcome to the Jungle’, which was released in theaters on June 26, 2026.
